entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
I need to make a return.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie with VeloFit. I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and the product you're calling about?
Sarah Miller. It's the VeloBand Pulse HR monitor.
Thank you, Sarah. I see your account here. Before we proceed, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Neither. I just don't need it anymore.
I understand. I do see the item was delivered about 41 days ago. Can you give me a bit more context on the situation? It just helps me find the right solution.

Fine. It was for my husband. He was about to leave for a military deployment, but there was a last-minute medical emergency. He ended up in the hospital and needed surgery. This return wasn't exactly my priority.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I certainly hope he's recovering well. Please give me just one moment to check our return policy for you.

Okay, thank you for your patience, Sarah. I've just reviewed our policy, and it looks like items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 41, you are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and process this for a full refund immediately.

Of course. I've just submitted the return request. You will receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next 10 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your husband a swift recovery.
